title: The Long Game: Light Fingers

texts.details:
Anyone can open a throat. It takes no art, and it leaves you a body and no answers.

I will teach you the other thing. A human came off the boat some days ago and has not gone on to the city. His name is Corwin Slade. He keeps to the trees west of here and meets no one by daylight. He carries messages for those who do not wish them read. I want what is in his pocket, $N. I do not want him dead. A dead courier is replaced, and the next I will not know.

Come at him from behind, unseen, and take it. If he sees you, withdraw, and return when he has forgotten.
texts.objectives: Pick the pocket of Corwin Slade, a human who lurks off the road west of Dolanaar, and bring the Crumpled Note he carries to your trainer. Killing him will not give it to you.
texts.progress: From behind, and silently. If he is dead you have failed, whatever you bring me.
texts.completion:
He felt nothing? Good. That is the craft, $N. All the rest is knife work.

Let me see. "Red stones, two crates. The buyers want them by the tower in Westfall before the moon turns." No names. There never are.

Red stones, carried through our forest by a human. I will send this to those whose work it is to worry. You have pulled a thread, and in this trade one never knows how long a thread is. Choose one of these. When you have twenty seasons, cross the sea to the human land of Westfall and find a woman called Kearnen, near the tower in the south-east. Tell her Jannok sent you about the stones.

idea: The Long Game, level 10 (Alliance): lift a note from a smuggler without killing him. The first pull on a thread that leads to the Syndicate. Invented: Corwin Slade and the note.
